# User Guide

## Installation

1. Clone the repository using `git clone https://github.com/your-username/your-repo-name.git`
2. Navigate into the cloned repository using `cd your-repo-name`
3. Install the required dependencies using `pip install -r requirements.txt`

## Configuration

1. Create a `config.json` file in the root directory with the following content:
```json
{
  "database": {
    "host": "localhost",
    "port": 5432,
    "username": "your-username",
    "password": "your-password"
  }
}
```
Replace the placeholders with your actual database credentials.

## Running Tests

1. Navigate into the project directory using `cd your-project-name`
2. Run the tests using `python -m unittest discover -s your-project-name`

## Getting Help

1. Open a terminal and run `python -m docopt docs/GUIDE.md --help` to view the usage instructions
2. If you encounter any issues, try searching for the issue on the Claude GitHub page or Stack Overflow
